plan.notes:
Official CSUDH Academic Catalog, Nursing B.S. (RN-BSN) program page, '4 Semester Roadmap' full-time plan (Plan of Study Grid). COMPLETION PROGRAM: this is the RN-to-BSN pathway for registered nurses / ADN graduates (not a freshman-entry plan); the 4-semester full-time sequence qualifies under the completion program_type gate (2-7 terms) per the official source, which states the nine required nursing major courses 'are designed to be completed in sequence according to the published full-time or part-time Roadmaps.' SOURCE PRINTS CATALOG YEAR 2026-2027 on this page (rest of catalog viewed was 2025-2026); stamped as printed. CREDIT RANGES AT LOWER BOUND per convention: 'Up to 10 additional transferable units (over 60 units transferred)' sequenced at 0 and 'NCLEX credit up to 24 hours to achieve 120 total hours' sequenced at 0, giving semester 4 = 3 and total_credits = 38 (source prints '3-37' and '38-72'). Students admitted in Spring or Summer follow the same roadmap disregarding Fall/Spring labels. BSN 346 satisfies GE 5UD, BSN 306 satisfies GE 4UD, ENG 350 satisfies GWAR per source. RN licensure required before the Community-Based Role Performance course. Prereq arrays empty: the roadmap publishes no per-course prerequisites and none are invented.

Pipeline notes (coordinator 2026-10-02): program_type "completion" = RN-to-BSN degree-completion program (38 cr, 4 semesters as published).
